jobs.title: Transportation Security & Loss Prevention Lead
jobs.description:
Insight Global is seeking a Transportation Security Manager in Houston, TX, to lead security and loss prevention efforts across a North American transportation network. The role involves investigating cargo theft, developing security protocols, and delivering training programs to enhance operational safety. Candidates should have experience in transportation security and logistics, strong analytical skills, and a background in cargo theft prevention.

jobs.title: Asset Protection Lead: Loss Prevention & Team Coach
jobs.description:
Macy's Inc. is seeking an Asset Protection Captain to lead training, supervision, and development of Loss Prevention staff to detect and prevent theft of company property.

You will implement prevention programs, participate in onboarding and ongoing training, and respond to incidents to minimize liability. Responsibilities include supervising staff, coordinating with law enforcement, preparing detailed reports, and maintaining compliance with laws and company policies.
